featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 新增 Codex、Claude Code、Grok 与 WorkBuddy 的本机用量看板、调用明细和趋势洞察。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Added local usage dashboards, call details, and trend insights for Codex, Claude Code, Grok, and WorkBuddy.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 新增基于 Hooks 的 AI 监控工作台、本地图片管理和配置写入流程。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Added a Hook-based AI monitoring workbench, local image management, and configuration workflow.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 新增 12 个纯位置编号的桌宠浮窗，以及拖拽、布局、分页、缩放和托盘控制。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Added a 12-position desktop pet overlay with dragging, layouts, paging, scaling, and tray controls.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 新增 Codex 与 WorkBuddy 本机换肤，内置六套主题并支持受控导入、导出、创建和恢复。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Added local Codex and WorkBuddy skins with six built-in themes plus controlled import, export, creation, and restore flows.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 为 Windows WorkBuddy 换肤增加受控 CDP 恢复：经用户确认后关闭官方路径下经过验证的旧进程树，并启动唯一的本机调试实例。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Added controlled CDP recovery for Windows WorkBuddy skins: after user confirmation, verified old process trees under official paths are closed and a single local-debugging instance is started.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 统一 Agent 启用面板，让用量看板、Hooks、桌宠与换肤只展示各自真实支持的类型。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Unified Agent enablement so usage dashboards, Hooks, desktop pets, and skins expose only the types they actually support.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 重组用量看板、AI 监控与应用换肤的设置和导航，精简换肤工具栏，并在应用信息中提供可离线打开的双语更新日志。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Reorganized settings and navigation for Usage Dashboard, AI Monitor, and App Skins, simplified the skins toolbar, and added offline bilingual release notes to app information.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 为 Windows 安装器与 macOS Finder 提供中英文应用显示名，并统一托盘菜单和应用换肤界面的本地化文案。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Added localized English and Chinese app display names for the Windows installer and macOS Finder, and aligned tray-menu and App Skins wording.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 在 macOS 与兼容 Linux 托盘中显示全部已启用来源的当天 Token 总量，并随扫描、配置变化和跨日刷新。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Added daily total token usage across all enabled sources to the macOS and compatible Linux tray, refreshed after scans, configuration changes, and day rollover.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 在设置中新增固定 GitHub 仓库入口，以及微信支付和支付宝赞助二维码。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Added a fixed GitHub repository link plus WeChat Pay and Alipay sponsorship QR codes to Settings.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复“全部”视图纳入未配置 Agent、默认路由漂移，以及设置、数据源、监控和换肤页面在查询失败或 Agent 切换后沿用过期状态的问题。
bugFixes.en-US: Fixed the All view including unconfigured Agents, default-route drift, and stale state in Settings, Sources, Monitor, and Skins after query failures or Agent switches.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复开机自启开关错误传递查询上下文、回读失败无法恢复，以及 Windows 新用户缺少 Run 注册表键时状态读取和启用失败；同时修复 macOS 通知授权和有界投递状态不同步的问题。
bugFixes.en-US: Fixed autostart passing query context to host commands, switch recovery after readback errors, and state reads or enabling on fresh Windows accounts without a Run registry key; also fixed stale macOS notification authorization and bounded-delivery state.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复生产构建中的 CSS 条件色兼容与样式入口裁剪，避免主题、导航、用量看板和监控界面丢失样式。
bugFixes.en-US: Fixed production CSS conditional-color compatibility and entry pruning so themes, navigation, usage dashboards, and monitoring views keep their styles.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复 Hooks 中继分段读取、配置原子写入与迁移、连接上限、Windows 中继缓存与安装目录冲突，以及 WSL/关机生命周期竞态，避免遗漏 AI 消息、卸载残留或残留进程。
bugFixes.en-US: Fixed Hook relay partial reads, atomic configuration writes and migrations, connection limits, the Windows rendezvous cache colliding with the install directory, and WSL/shutdown lifecycle races that could miss AI events, leave uninstall residue, or leave processes behind.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复桌宠冷启动占位、图片协议、位置绑定、托盘显隐和设置窗生命周期问题。
bugFixes.en-US: Fixed desktop pet cold-start placeholders, image protocol handling, position binding, tray visibility, and settings-window lifecycle.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复扫描、保留清理与本机索引任务的所有权、取消和单写入隔离，防止旧进度污染新任务、数据库争用和退出挂起。
bugFixes.en-US: Fixed ownership, cancellation, and single-writer isolation for scans, retention cleanup, and local indexing to prevent stale progress, database contention, and shutdown hangs.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复元数据与手动数据源发现的有限预算、共享取消、截止时间和迟到结果隔离，避免扫描超时后继续写入旧状态。
bugFixes.en-US: Fixed bounded budgets, shared cancellation, deadlines, and late-result isolation in metadata and manual source discovery so timed-out scans cannot overwrite current state.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复自定义 Cargo 资源解析、版本载体、Windows WMI、图标与原生对话框，以及 DMG 安装布局的打包漂移。
bugFixes.en-US: Fixed packaging drift across custom Cargo resource resolution, version carriers, Windows WMI, icons and native dialogs, and the DMG installation layout.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复 Windows Codex 与 WorkBuddy 换肤的可信可执行文件、商店激活、端口和进程树绑定，并为旧版脚本保留明确的一次性确认。
bugFixes.en-US: Fixed trusted executable, Store activation, port, and process-tree binding for Windows Codex and WorkBuddy skins while retaining explicit one-time consent for legacy scripts.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复 macOS 换肤签名、资源和进程所有权，以及安装、重启、导入、文件管理、watcher 与 CDP handler 在取消、回滚和跨代切换时的清理竞态。
bugFixes.en-US: Fixed macOS skin signing, resource, and process ownership plus cleanup races across install, restart, import, file management, watchers, and CDP handlers during cancellation, rollback, and generation changes.
